semantic.justification: Native optional fragment failure, basename lowercase retry, relation caching and strict/transitional root resolution; part-local/global relation ID counters and IURI conversion. Ports only the consumed XML/package contract; native UNO services, general storage hierarchy, encrypted/ZIP64 packages, XLSB RecordParser and complete application document filters are outside this prerequisite. Strings/byte arrays and Promises bind host XML/ZIP transport; whole-module parity remains unverified. V4DQJW adds native FastSaxSerializer/FastSerializerHelper text/byte export, original1MiB cache, ordered token/value emission, XML10 and literal x-escape rules, APPEND/PREPEND/POSTPONE marks and original sorted buckets. XmlFilterBase now owns the native fragment-serializer factory with original no-header/VML/+xml predicate. Actual ZipFragmentStream/ZipStorage, OOXML token names and relationship/content-type owners are reused. Caller-provided actual FastTokenHandler replaces native component-service acquisition; no fake global context or token catalog is introduced. UTF16 host strings use the existing UTF8 byte transport binding; no exact claim is made for invalid UTF16 conversion or malformed UTF8 diagnostics. Physical buffers/refcounts/debug structural stacks are erased under GC; native output preconditions become host errors. File-local native invalidChar is exported only for source-scoped algorithm testing. FastAttributeList/VML raw-attribute overload, native numeric/double overloads and complete DOCX/XLSX export orchestration remain pending. No document/file UI behavior or whole-native parity is claimed; previous statuses and intentional file workflows remain unchanged.
